# Sources of the Azure fixtures

Everything outside `synthetic/` is copied unchanged from public repositories (one deviation, below). Nothing here was read from a real tenant.

## Format

The files from `azure-rest-api-specs` are the official request/response *example* files. Each has `parameters` (the request: path ids and `api-version`, plus the body of a PUT or PATCH) and `responses` (status code to headers and body). A converter must read the resource from `responses.200.body` (GET, list) or from `parameters` (PUT body), not from the top level. Names are `<api-version>__<original file name>`; the version is the swagger the example belongs to.

## One deviation from upstream

The Logic App `callbackUrl` in the upstream action group examples carries a `sig=` value that looks like a real signed URL. It is replaced by `sig=REDACTED-IN-FIXTURE` in these files (so a secret scanner stays quiet): `action_groups/2021-09-01__createOrUpdateActionGroup.json`, `action_groups/2021-09-01__postTestNotifications.json`, `action_groups/2021-09-01__postTestNotificationsAtActionGroupResourceLevel.json`, `action_groups/2021-09-01__postTestNotificationsAtResourceGroupLevel.json`, `action_groups/2023-01-01__createOrUpdateActionGroup.json`, `action_groups/2023-01-01__postTestNotificationsAtActionGroupResourceLevel.json`. Everything else is byte-identical to upstream.

## SYNTHETIC hostile cases

Written for this repository. Not from Microsoft, not real resources. Every file has a top-level `_synthetic` field and the name starts with `SYNTHETIC__`. Ids are all-zero placeholders, hosts are `example.invalid`, every secret-looking value says SYNTHETIC. They are meant to make a parser fail loudly or degrade cleanly.

| File | What it tests |
|---|---|
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__action_group_secrets_in_uris.json` | secrets in webhook `serviceUri` (user:password and `token=`), Logic App `sig=`, Function `code=`, Automation `serviceUri`; AAD-authenticated webhook ids |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__action_group_unicode_and_empty.json` | empty short name, disabled group, empty strings, plus-addressing, unicode name, Event Hub receiver |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__action_group_unknown_receiver_types.json` | receiver arrays the swagger does not define (`pagerDutyReceivers`, `slackReceivers`, `futureReceivers`), null array, webhook without `serviceUri`, over-long short name, bad country code |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__activity_log_alert_missing_condition.json` | no `condition`, empty action group list |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__activity_log_alert_odd_fields.json` | nested `anyOf`, unknown field, null `equals`, empty `containsAny` entry, null webhook property |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__alert_processing_rule_unknown_action.json` | unknown `actionType`, unknown condition field and operator, empty values, impossible dates, unknown time zone, `Yearly` recurrence, `Funday` weekday |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__dashboard_odd.json` | dashboard lens with a null part, a zero-size part, an unknown part type, null metadata |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__list_page_with_nextlink.json` | a list response whose `nextLink` points to a second page |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__metric_alert_dimensions_wildcard.json` | dynamic threshold with 4 of 4 failing periods, `ignoreDataBefore`, dimension `*` and an empty `Exclude` list, empty actions |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__metric_alert_missing_properties.json` | no `properties` object at all |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__metric_alert_nulls_and_missing.json` | every property present but null |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__metric_alert_unicode_names.json` | unicode and right-to-left override in names, tags and description; template-injection characters (`${`, `%{`, backticks, quotes, newlines) |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__metric_alert_unknown_criteria_type.json` | unknown `odata.type`, unknown `criterionType`, severity 9, string threshold, unknown top-level field, zero window |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__prometheus_rule_group_odd.json` | recording rule, alert with regex matcher and `on()` join, `for` of zero, null severity, Handlebars-like annotations, auto-resolve |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__scheduled_query_rule_hostile_kql.json` | KQL with a `let` function, `join`, `${jndi:...}`, `%{if}`, comments, backticks, a non-ASCII identifier, line separator in the display name; `overrideQueryTimeRange`, `muteActionsDuration`, `autoMitigate` false |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__scheduled_query_rule_nulls_and_cross_resource.json` | two workspaces in scope, cross-workspace `union workspace('b')`, null aggregation, operator and threshold, null actions, null kind |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__scheduled_query_rule_unknown_kind.json` | unknown `kind`, dynamic threshold on a log rule, 3 of 6 failing periods, measure and resource id columns |
| `synthetic/SYNTHETIC__smart_detector_odd.json` | severity `Sev9`, custom webhook payload with `${` |

## Sources checked and not used

- `Microsoft.Portal` dashboards: only preview API versions exist in the pinned specification (2025-04-01-preview is the latest); the stable/preview split is documented in `docs/research/azure-monitor-alerting.md`.
- Workbooks from `azure-quickstart-templates`: no workbook template was found in `quickstarts/microsoft.insights` at the pinned commit; the workbook samples are the official swagger examples instead.
